## CARD 1: 🔗 ENTITY RESOLUTION AGENT
Deterministic cross-verification of bidder identities.
Reconciles legal entity names across GST, PAN, Udyam, Financial and Bid Document records without fuzzy distortion.

## CARD 2: ⚙️ DETERMINISTIC IDENTITY RULES
Deterministic identity consistency rules:
• Legal suffix equivalence (Pvt Ltd / Private Limited)
• GSTIN ↔ PAN embedded character reconciliation
• Format validation for PAN, GSTIN, and Udyam
• Cross-source name discrepancy and conflict detection
